paragraphs.en: Hindsight™ is an agent memory system built to create smarter agents that learn over time. Most agent memory systems focus on recalling conversation history. Hindsight is focused on making agents that learn, not just remember.
paragraphs.zh: Hindsight™ 是一个智能体记忆系统，旨在构建能够随时间不断学习的更智能的智能体。 大多数智能体记忆系统专注于回忆对话历史。 Hindsight 专注于打造会学习的智能体，而不仅仅是会记住的智能体。

sents.en: Hindsight™ is an agent memory system built to create smarter agents that learn over time.
sents.zh: Hindsight™ 是一个智能体记忆系统，旨在构建能够随时间不断学习的更智能的智能体。

sents.en: Most agent memory systems focus on recalling conversation history.
sents.zh: 大多数智能体记忆系统专注于回忆对话历史。

sents.en: Hindsight is focused on making agents that learn, not just remember.
sents.zh: Hindsight 专注于打造会学习的智能体，而不仅仅是会记住的智能体。

paragraphs.en: It eliminates the shortcomings of alternative techniques such as RAG and knowledge graph and delivers state-of-the-art performance on long term memory tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 它消除了 RAG 和知识图谱等替代技术的缺点，并在长期记忆任务上提供了最先进的性能。

paragraphs.en: Hindsight is the most accurate agent memory system ever tested according to benchmark performance. It has achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark, widely used to assess memory system performance across a variety of conversational AI scenarios. paragraphs.en: Live, continuously updated results — including per-model accuracy, latency and cost — are published at benchmarks.hindsight.vectorize.io .
paragraphs.zh: 实时的、持续更新的结果——包括每个模型的准确率、延迟和成本——发布于 benchmarks.hindsight.vectorize.io。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark performance data for Hindsight has been independently reproduced by research collaborators at the Virginia Tech Sanghani Center for Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics and The Washington Post. Other scores are self-reported by software vendors.

paragraphs.en: Hindsight works with 25+ LLM providers via HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_PROVIDER — hosted ( openai , anthropic , gemini , groq , bedrock , vertexai , minimax , deepseek , atlas , meta , …), fully local ( ollama , lmstudio , llamacpp ), any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and gateways ( litellm , litellmrouter ) that reach the rest. Existing subscriptions work too: openai-codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro), claude-code (Claude Pro/Max), cursor (Cursor) and github-copilot (GitHub Copilot) need no API key. See supported models .
paragraphs.zh: Hindsight 通过 HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_PROVIDER 支持 25+ 个大语言模型提供商——托管服务（openai、anthropic、gemini、groq、bedrock、vertexai、minimax、deepseek、atlas、meta 等）、完全本地方案（ollama、lmstudio、llamacpp）、任何 OpenAI 兼容端点，以及可触达其余提供商的网关（litellm、litellmrouter）。 现有订阅同样可用：openai-codex（ChatGPT Plus/Pro）、claude-code（Claude Pro/Max）、cursor（Cursor）和 github-copilot（GitHub Copilot）无需 API 密钥。请参阅受支持的模型。

paragraphs.en: pip install hindsight-client -U # Python npm install @vectorize-io/hindsight-client # Node.js / TypeScript go get github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/hindsight-clients/go # Go curl -fsSL https://hindsight.vectorize.io/get-cli | bash # CLI Python from hindsight_client import Hindsight client = Hindsight ( base_url = "http://localhost:8888" ) # Retain: Store information client . retain ( bank_id = "my-bank" , content = "Alice works at Google as a software engineer" ) # Recall: Search memories client . recall ( bank_id = "my-bank" , query = "What does Alice do?" ) # Reflect: Generate disposition-aware response client . reflect ( bank_id = "my-bank" , query = "Tell me about Alice" ) Node.js / TypeScript const { HindsightClient } = require ( '@vectorize-io/hindsight-client' ) ; const main = async ( ) => { const client = new HindsightClient ( { baseUrl : 'http://localhost:8888' } ) ; await client . retain ( 'my-bank' , 'Alice loves hiking in Yosemite' ) ; const results = await client . recall ( 'my-bank' , 'What does Alice like?' ) ; console . log ( results ) ; } main ( ) ; Full reference: Python · Node.js · Go · CLI · REST API
paragraphs.zh: pip install hindsight-client -U # Python npm install @vectorize-io/hindsight-client # Node.js / TypeScript go get github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/hindsight-clients/go # Go curl -fsSL https://hindsight.vectorize.io/get-cli | bash # CLI Python from hindsight_client import Hindsight client = Hindsight ( base_url = "http://localhost:8888" ) # Retain（保留）：存储信息 client . retain ( bank_id = "my-bank" , content = "Alice 在 Google 担任软件工程师" ) # Recall（回忆）：搜索记忆 client . recall ( bank_id = "my-bank" , query = "Alice 是做什么的？" ) # Reflect（反思）：生成具有倾向性感知的响应 client . reflect ( bank_id = "my-bank" , query = "介绍一下 Alice" ) Node.js / TypeScript const { HindsightClient } = require ( '@vectorize-io/hindsight-client' ) ; const main = async ( ) => { const client = new HindsightClient ( { baseUrl : 'http://localhost:8888' } ) ; await client . retain ( 'my-bank' , 'Alice 喜欢在优胜美地徒步' ) ; const results = await client . recall ( 'my-bank' , 'Alice 喜欢什么？' ) ; console . log ( results ) ; } main ( ) ; 完整参考文档：Python · Node.js · Go · CLI · REST API

paragraphs.en: import os from hindsight import HindsightServer , HindsightClient with HindsightServer ( llm_provider = "openai" , llm_model = "gpt-5-mini" , llm_api_key = os . environ [ "OPENAI_API_KEY" ] ) as server : client = HindsightClient ( base_url = server . url ) client . retain ( bank_id = "my-bank" , content = "Alice works at Google" ) results = client . recall ( bank_id = "my-bank" , query = "Where does Alice work?" ) A Node.js equivalent and a daemon CLI are also available.
paragraphs.zh:
```python
import os
from hindsight import HindsightServer, HindsightClient

with HindsightServer(
    llm_provider="openai",
    llm_model="gpt-5-mini",
    llm_api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"],
) as server:
    client = HindsightClient(base_url=server.url)
    client.retain(bank_id="my-bank", content="Alice works at Google")
    results = client.recall(bank_id="my-bank", query="Where does Alice work?")
```

此外还提供了等效的 Node.js 版本以及守护进程 CLI。

paragraphs.en: The easiest way to add memory to an existing agent is the LLM Wrapper. Swap your LLM client for a wrapped one — memories are then stored and retrieved automatically on every call, with no other changes to your code.
paragraphs.zh: 为现有智能体添加记忆的最简单方法是使用 LLM Wrapper。 将你的 LLM 客户端替换为包装后的客户端——之后每次调用都会自动存储和检索记忆，无需对代码做任何其他更改。

sents.en: The easiest way to add memory to an existing agent is the LLM Wrapper.
sents.zh: 为现有智能体添加记忆的最简单方法是使用 LLM Wrapper。

sents.en: Swap your LLM client for a wrapped one — memories are then stored and retrieved automatically on every call, with no other changes to your code.
sents.zh: 将你的 LLM 客户端替换为包装后的客户端——之后每次调用都会自动存储和检索记忆，无需对代码做任何其他更改。

paragraphs.en: pip install hindsight-litellm from openai import OpenAI from hindsight_litellm import wrap_openai # Wrap your existing LLM client and you're done. # Defaults to Hindsight Cloud; pass hindsight_api_url for a self-hosted server. client = wrap_openai ( OpenAI (), bank_id = "user-123" , hindsight_api_url = "http://localhost:8888" , ) # Hindsight recalls relevant memories before the call # and retains the conversation after it. response = client . chat . completions . create ( model = "gpt-5-mini" , messages = [{ "role" : "user" , "content" : "What do you know about me?" }], ) wrap_anthropic() does the same for the Anthropic SDK, and every setting — bank, recall budget, fact types, reflect instead of recall — can be overridden per call with hindsight_* kwargs. LiteLLM sits underneath, so the same integration covers 100+ models . See the LiteLLM integration .
paragraphs.zh: pip install hindsight-litellm from openai import OpenAI from hindsight_litellm import wrap_openai # 包装你现有的 LLM 客户端，就完成了。 # 默认使用 Hindsight Cloud；自托管服务器时请传入 hindsight_api_url。 client = wrap_openai ( OpenAI (), bank_id = "user-123" , hindsight_api_url = "http://localhost:8888" , ) # Hindsight 会在调用之前召回相关记忆， # 并在调用之后保留对话内容。 response = client . chat . completions . create ( model = "gpt-5-mini" , messages = [{ "role" : "user" , "content" : "你对我了解多少？" }], ) wrap_anthropic() 为 Anthropic SDK 提供同样的功能，并且所有设置——bank、召回预算、事实类型、用 reflect 代替 recall——都可以通过 hindsight_* 关键字参数在每次调用时进行覆盖。 底层由 LiteLLM 支持，因此同一套集成即可覆盖 100 多种模型。 参见 LiteLLM 集成。

paragraphs.en: One package gives CLI coding agents long-term project memory: a per-repo bank built automatically from git history and past sessions, injected into the agent as it starts working, plus curated knowledge pages covering architecture, conventions and in-flight work.

paragraphs.en: Most agent memory implementations rely on basic vector search or sometimes use a knowledge graph. Hindsight uses biomimetic data structures to organize agent memories in a way that is more like how human memory works:
paragraphs.zh: 大多数智能体记忆实现都依赖基础的向量检索，或者有时使用知识图谱。 Hindsight 使用仿生数据结构来组织智能体记忆，使其更像人类记忆的工作方式：

sents.en: Most agent memory implementations rely on basic vector search or sometimes use a knowledge graph.
sents.zh: 大多数智能体记忆实现都依赖基础的向量检索，或者有时使用知识图谱。

sents.en: Hindsight uses biomimetic data structures to organize agent memories in a way that is more like how human memory works:
sents.zh: Hindsight 使用仿生数据结构来组织智能体记忆，使其更像人类记忆的工作方式：

paragraphs.en: Memories live in banks . When memories are added, they are pushed into either the world facts or the experiences pathway, then represented as a combination of entities, relationships, and time series with sparse/dense vector representations to aid in later recall.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆存储在记忆库中。 当添加记忆时，它们会被推送到世界事实或经历通道中，然后表示为实体、关系和时间序列的组合，并采用稀疏/稠密向量表示，以便于后续的回忆。

sents.en: Memories live in banks .
sents.zh: 记忆存储在记忆库中。

sents.en: When memories are added, they are pushed into either the world facts or the experiences pathway, then represented as a combination of entities, relationships, and time series with sparse/dense vector representations to aid in later recall.
sents.zh: 当添加记忆时，它们会被推送到世界事实或经历通道中，然后表示为实体、关系和时间序列的组合，并采用稀疏/稠密向量表示，以便于后续的回忆。

paragraphs.en: The retain operation is used to push new memories into Hindsight. It tells Hindsight to retain the information you pass in as an input.
paragraphs.zh: retain 操作用于将新的记忆推入 Hindsight。 它告诉 Hindsight 保留你作为输入传入的信息。

sents.en: The retain operation is used to push new memories into Hindsight.
sents.zh: retain 操作用于将新的记忆推入 Hindsight。

sents.en: It tells Hindsight to retain the information you pass in as an input.
sents.zh: 它告诉 Hindsight 保留你作为输入传入的信息。

paragraphs.en: client . retain ( bank_id = "my-bank" , content = "Alice got promoted to senior engineer" , context = "career update" , timestamp = "2025-06-15T10:00:00Z" , ) Behind the scenes, retain uses an LLM to extract key facts, temporal data, entities, and relationships. It passes these through a normalization process to transform extracted data into canonical entities, time series, and search indexes along with metadata. These representations create the pathways for accurate memory retrieval in the recall and reflect operations.
paragraphs.zh: client.retain(bank_id="my-bank", content="Alice got promoted to senior engineer", context="career update", timestamp="2025-06-15T10:00:00Z",) 在幕后，retain 使用大语言模型（LLM）来提取关键事实、时间数据、实体和关系。 它将这些数据经过归一化处理，把提取出的数据转换为规范化的实体、时间序列和搜索索引，并附带元数据。 这些表示形式为 recall 和 reflect 操作中准确的记忆检索创造了通路。

sents.en: client . retain ( bank_id = "my-bank" , content = "Alice got promoted to senior engineer" , context = "career update" , timestamp = "2025-06-15T10:00:00Z" , ) Behind the scenes, retain uses an LLM to extract key facts, temporal data, entities, and relationships.
sents.zh: client.retain(bank_id="my-bank", content="Alice got promoted to senior engineer", context="career update", timestamp="2025-06-15T10:00:00Z",) 在幕后，retain 使用大语言模型（LLM）来提取关键事实、时间数据、实体和关系。

sents.en: These representations create the pathways for accurate memory retrieval in the recall and reflect operations.
sents.zh: 这些表示形式为 recall 和 reflect 操作中准确的记忆检索创造了通路。

paragraphs.en: The recall operation is used to retrieve memories. These memories can come from any of the memory types (world, experiences, etc.)
paragraphs.zh: 召回操作用于检索记忆。 这些记忆可以来自任意记忆类型（世界、经历等）。

sents.en: The recall operation is used to retrieve memories.
sents.zh: 召回操作用于检索记忆。

sents.en: These memories can come from any of the memory types (world, experiences, etc.)
sents.zh: 这些记忆可以来自任意记忆类型（世界、经历等）。

paragraphs.en: The individual results are merged, ordered by relevance using reciprocal rank fusion and a cross-encoder reranking model, then trimmed as needed to fit within the token limit.
paragraphs.zh: 各个单独的结果会被合并，通过倒数排名融合（reciprocal rank fusion）和交叉编码器重排模型按相关性排序，然后根据需要进行裁剪以符合 token 上限。

paragraphs.en: The reflect operation performs a more thorough analysis of existing memories. This allows the agent to form new connections between memories and build a more thorough understanding of its world — or to answer a question that needs deep thinking rather than lookup.
paragraphs.zh: 反思（reflect）操作会对已有记忆进行更深入的分析。 这使智能体能够在记忆之间建立新的联系，从而对其所处的世界形成更透彻的理解——或者回答一个需要深度思考而非简单查找的问题。

sents.en: The reflect operation performs a more thorough analysis of existing memories.
sents.zh: 反思（reflect）操作会对已有记忆进行更深入的分析。

sents.en: This allows the agent to form new connections between memories and build a more thorough understanding of its world — or to answer a question that needs deep thinking rather than lookup.
sents.zh: 这使智能体能够在记忆之间建立新的联系，从而对其所处的世界形成更透彻的理解——或者回答一个需要深度思考而非简单查找的问题。

paragraphs.en: Retained facts don't stay a flat pile. In the background, Hindsight consolidates related facts into observations — deduplicated beliefs the bank has built up over time. Each observation keeps its supporting evidence with exact quotes and a proof count, and is refined rather than overwritten when new evidence arrives, so new information strengthens, weakens or extends an existing belief instead of silently replacing it.
paragraphs.zh: 保留的事实不会停留在一堆扁平的条目中。 在后台，Hindsight 会将相关事实整合为观察（observations）——即智能体随时间积累起来的、经过去重信念。 每条观察都保留其支持证据（含精确引文和证明计数），并在新证据到来时被细化而非被覆盖，因此新信息会强化、削弱或扩展现有信念，而不是悄悄将其替换。

sents.zh: 保留的事实不会停留在一堆扁平的条目中。

sents.en: In the background, Hindsight consolidates related facts into observations — deduplicated beliefs the bank has built up over time.

paragraphs.en: A mental model is a standing answer to a question about a bank ("What are this user's preferences?"). You define the question once; Hindsight writes the answer, stores it, and rewrites it in the background as the bank learns more. Reading one is a database read — no retrieval, no LLM call — so an agent can boot with a page of settled knowledge instead of rediscovering it every session.
paragraphs.zh: 心智模型是对关于知识库的一个问题的常驻答案（“该用户的偏好是什么？”）。 你只需定义一次问题；Hindsight 会撰写答案、存储它，并在知识库学到更多内容时在后台重写它。 读取它就是一次数据库读取——无需检索，无需调用大语言模型——因此智能体可以带着一页确定的知识启动，而不必在每个会话中重新发现这些知识。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge pages are mental models with the mechanics hidden: living documents a bank writes about itself, organized in folders like a wiki, searchable, and projectable onto disk as ordinary markdown. Supply a name and a question; every other decision is a default you can override.
paragraphs.zh: 知识页面是隐藏了内部机制的心智模型：它们是银行撰写的关于自身的活文档，像 wiki 一样按文件夹组织、可搜索，并且能以普通 markdown 的形式投射到磁盘上。 只需提供一个名称和一个问题；其余所有决定都采用默认值，你可以随时覆盖。

paragraphs.en: A bank is an isolated memory store — one "brain" for one user, agent, or project. Isolation is strict: no cross-bank leakage. Banks carry background context and disposition traits (skepticism, literalism, empathy) that shape how reflect reasons over their memories, and can be created from declarative bank templates .
paragraphs.zh: Bank 是一个隔离的内存存储——每个用户、智能体或项目对应一个「大脑」。 隔离是严格的：不同 bank 之间不会泄漏信息。 Bank 携带背景上下文和性格倾向（怀疑、字面化、共情），这些会影响 reflect 如何对其记忆进行推理，并且可以从声明式 bank 模板创建。

sents.en: Isolation is strict: no cross-bank leakage.
sents.zh: 隔离是严格的：不同 bank 之间不会泄漏信息。

paragraphs.en: Hindsight is built to support conversational AI agents as well as agents that are intended to perform tasks autonomously. The ideal use case for Hindsight are agents that require a blend of these features such as AI employees that need to handle open-ended tasks, change behavior based on user feedback, and learn to perform complex tasks to automate work at a level that approximates a human work. Hindsight can be used with simple AI workflows like those built with n8n and other similar tools, but may be overkill for such applications.
paragraphs.zh: Hindsight 旨在同时支持对话式智能体以及旨在自主执行任务的智能体。 Hindsight 的理想使用场景是那些需要兼具这些特性的智能体，例如需要处理开放式任务、根据用户反馈调整行为，并学习执行复杂任务以在接近人类工作水平的层面实现工作自动化的 AI 员工。 Hindsight 可以与使用 n8n 及其他类似工具构建的简单 AI 工作流配合使用，但对这类应用来说可能有些大材小用。

paragraphs.en: One of the simpler use cases you can use Hindsight for is to personalize AI chatbots and other conversational agents by storing and recalling memories associated with individual users.
paragraphs.zh: Hindsight 的一个较为简单的用例是，通过存储和召回与个别用户相关的记忆，来个性化 AI 聊天机器人和其他对话式智能体。

paragraphs.en: Satisfying these requirements in Hindsight is straightforward. When new user inputs and tool calls are ingested into Hindsight using the retain operation, custom metadata can be used to enrich the new memories. Metadata provides a convenient way to isolate memories that need to be restricted to a given user. Once these are fed into the retain operation, any raw memories and mental models that get created can be filtered when retrieving relevant memories.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Hindsight 中满足这些要求非常简单直接。 当使用 retain 操作将新的用户输入和工具调用存入 Hindsight 时，可以使用自定义元数据来丰富新的记忆。 元数据提供了一种便捷的方式来隔离需要限制于特定用户的记忆。 一旦这些内容被输入到 retain 操作中，创建的任何原始记忆和心理模型都可以在检索相关记忆时被过滤。

sents.zh: 当使用 retain 操作将新的用户输入和工具调用存入 Hindsight 时，可以使用自定义元数据来丰富新的记忆。

sents.en: Metadata provides a convenient way to isolate memories that need to be restricted to a given user.
